fullPassage: Once long ago, deep in the Himalayas, there lived a little panda. He was as ordinary as all the other pandas. He was completely white from head to toe. His two big ears, his four furry feet and his cute round nose were all frosty white, leaving him feeling ordinary and sad. Unlike the cheerful and contented pandas around him, he desired to be distinctive, special, and unique. Driven by the desire for uniqueness, the little panda sought inspiration from his distant cousin, a giant white panda covered with heavenly black patches. But the cousin revealed the patches were from an unintended encounter with mud, and he disliked them. Disappointed, the little panda walked home. On his way, he met a red-feathered peacock, who explained he turned red from eating wild berries. The little panda changed his path and hurried to the nearest berry bush, greedily eating a mouthful of juicy red berries. However, they were so bitter he couldn't swallow even one. At dusk, he finally got home and slowly climbed his favorite bamboo tree. There, he discovered a strange black and red flower with a sweet scent that tempted him to eat all its blossoms. The following morning, under sunny skies, the little panda felt remarkably better. During breakfast, he found the other pandas chatting enthusiastically and asked why. They burst into laughter, exclaiming, 'Look at yourself!' Glancing down, he discovered his once white fur was now stained jet black and glowing red. He was overjoyed and realized that, rather than by imitating others, his wishes can come true from unexpected places and genuine experiences.

Driven by the desire for uniqueness, the little panda sought inspiration from his distant cousin, a giant white panda covered with heavenly black patches. But the cousin revealed the patches were from an unintended encounter with mud, and he disliked them. Disappointed, the little panda walked home. On his way, he met a red-feathered peacock, who explained he turned red from eating wild berries. The little panda changed his path and hurried to the nearest berry bush, greedily eating a mouthful of juicy red berries. However, they were so bitter he couldn't swallow even one. At dusk, he finally got home and slowly climbed his favorite bamboo tree. There, he discovered a strange black and red flower with a sweet scent that tempted him to eat all its blossoms. det.korean: 그는 다른 모든 판다들만큼이나 평범했다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① normal(보통의): ordinary와 유의어로 반의어가 아님
✅ ② remarkable(눈에 띄는, 특별한): ordinary(평범한)의 반의어
❌ ③ frequent(잦은): 빈도를 나타내어 의미 축이 다름
❌ ④ silent(조용한): 소리와 관련되어 의미 축이 다름
det.tip: ordinary(평범한)의 반의어는 remarkable, extraordinary, special입니다. normal은 유의어입니다.

questions.passage:

(B) She <u>turned</u> the key slowly and the heavy wooden door finally opened.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 turned의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) 공작은 열매를 먹고 붉게 '변했다'. (B) 그녀는 열쇠를 '돌렸다'.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 의미가 뒤바뀜. (A)는 '변하다', (B)는 '돌리다'
❌ ② (A)는 '뒤집다'가 아니라 색이 '변하다'
✅ ③ (A) (어떤 상태로) 변하다 — (B) ~을 돌리다: (A)에서는 붉게 '변했다', (B)에서는 열쇠를 '돌렸다'는 뜻으로 정확
❌ ④ (B)는 '뒤집다'가 아니라 열쇠를 '돌리다'
det.tip: turn은 '(상태로) 변하다', '돌리다, 회전시키다', '차례' 등 여러 뜻을 가진 다의어입니다.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "real and exactly what it appears to be; not false"

det.analysis:
✅ ① genuine(진정한, 진짜의): '진짜이며 거짓이 아닌'이라는 영영 정의에 정확히 부합
❌ ② artificial(인위적인): genuine의 반의어
❌ ③ temporary(일시적인): 시간과 관련된 뜻으로 무관
❌ ④ obvious(명백한): '분명한'이라는 뜻으로 정의와 다름
det.tip: genuine은 '진정한, 진짜의'라는 뜻입니다. real, authentic과 유의어이고, fake, artificial이 반의어입니다.

det.korean: 독특함에 대한 열망에 이끌려, 작은 판다는 거대한 흰 판다인 먼 사촌에게서 영감을 구했다.
det.analysis: drive → Driven: 분사구문. 판다가 열망에 '이끌리는' 수동 의미이므로 과거분사 Driven을 씁니다. 'Driven by ~'는 '~에 이끌려'라는 뜻이며 문장 첫 글자라 대문자 D
det.tip: 분사구문에서 주어가 동작을 '당하는' 수동 관계이면 과거분사(p.p.)를 씁니다. drive-drove-driven

det.korean: 그는 남다르고, 특별하며, 독특해지기를 원했다.

det.korean: 그는 남을 모방하는 것이 아니라 예상치 못한 곳과 진정한 경험에서 소원이 이루어질 수 있음을 깨달았다.
